transcript.title: Opening
transcript.text: Good morning Rushil Bhatia. Here is your daily news for Wednesday, October 14. In today's briefing: top headlines, bhopal and madhya pradesh, business and markets, money, tax and personal finance, science and technology, development and policy, across india, around the world. Let's begin.

transcript.title: Top headlines
transcript.text: First, the stories leading the news this morning. Ohio brothers bought flooded quarry for $330,000; village later drops seizure bid. Two Ohio brothers bought a flooded quarry for $330,000 in 2005 and spent 15 years improving it before a dispute with the Village of Luckey disrupted their planned sale. After nearly five years of litigation, the village abandoned its attempt to acquire the property through eminent domain but now faces a $206,000 legal bill, with the settlement still under dispute.Is this conversation helpful so far? Opposition's plea in SC: INDIA bloc challenges SIR process but not its validity. Why did opposition INDIA bloc, after making special intensive revision (SIR) of electoral rolls the central point of its attack on Election Commission and govt, give up the challenge to the constitutional and statutory validity of SIR in their joint writ petition before Supreme Court? WTC table: SA crash out of top two after Durban defeat; Where are India?. South Africa faced a significant defeat against Australia by 214 runs in the first Test at Durban. This loss caused South Africa to drop to third place in the ICC World Test Championship standings. Australia, with nine wins from eleven matches, remains at the top of the table. Matt Renshaw was instrumental in Australia's success, scoring 190 runs in the first innings. CJP's Das, Ranka arrested for Jantar Mantar trespass, to be produced before magistrate. Delhi Police have arrested Cockroach Janata Party (CJP) activists Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka and others for allegedly trespassing at the Jantar Mantar protest site in New Delhi. L Murugan offers to resign, sparks Union Cabinet reshuffle buzz. Union minister L Murugan on Tuesday offered to resign from the Cabinet and Rajya Sabha, saying he wanted to return to politics in his home state, Tamil Nadu, after being part of govt for over five years. 13 dead as boat capsizes in Ganga in Bihar's Vaishali, several missing. In a heart-wrenching event in the Raghopur Diara vicinity of Vaishali district, a boat capsized, tragically involving many children. The local community is in distress, with RJD leader Tejashwi Yadav voicing his grief and urging immediate rescue actions. The administration is actively working to hasten relief efforts and support victims, while officials keep a vigilant watch on the unfolding situation. Canada PM Carney to be Republic Day chief guest?. In a phone conversation on Tuesday, PM Modi and his Canadian counterpart, Mark Carney, reaffirmed their commitment to finalising the Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement at the earliest and doubling bilateral trade by 2030. Lee Marvin's restored 1936 Tucson estate listed for $5.75M. Lee Marvin's stunning estate in Tucson is back on the market after an extensive renovation, blending its historic adobe charm with modern-day luxuries. This unique property designed by the renowned architect Josias Joesler features seven spacious bedrooms, a separate guest house, and expansive recreational spaces spread over 4.19 acres. Initially purchased for $1. Generate questions at last minute to prevent paper leaks: Nilekani. Question papers for high-stakes entrance examinations could be generated at the last minute from a massive bank of questions instead of being prepared and stored in advance, as part of a technology-driven overhaul to prevent leaks, Nandan Nilekani, chairperson of the high-powered task force on examination reforms, said on Tuesday. Kentucky widow wins half of $2.33m accounts after husband dies without will. A Kentucky appeals court has upheld a widow's right to half of her late husband's $2.33 million investment accounts, despite his children being named as beneficiaries. William E. Perrine died without a will in 2024. The court also ruled that his widow, Nancy, was entitled to half of $126,000 gifted to his children and grandchildren shortly before his death. 'It's a no-brainer': EAM underlines need for stable border for normal ties with China. External affairs minister S Jaishankar on Tuesday said that if China wants a normal relationship with New Delhi, the border between the two countries has to be stable. Scientists discover 'hidden materials' that may lead to better batteries and solar fuels. A dedicated research team has unveiled hidden materials by analyzing molecular transformations during heating. Their discovery includes a newly identified form of bismuth vanadate that boasts an expanded band gap, potentially revolutionizing solar energy applications. Furthermore, they pinpointed transient phases with remarkable lithium storage capabilities, hinting at advancements in battery technology.

transcript.title: Bhopal and Madhya Pradesh
transcript.text: Now, news closer to home in Bhopal and across Madhya Pradesh. Bhopal Man Arrested For Allegedly Molesting Colleague's 9-Year-Old Daughter, Attempting To Rape Her During Overnight Stay. Bhopal's Kajlikheda police arrested a 36-year-old man for allegedly molesting and attempting to rape his colleague's nine-year-old daughter during an overnight stay in August. Madhya Pradesh SVAMITVA Scheme Sees Just 4,000 Property Registrations Against 50 Lakh Target, Patwaris End Strike After Government Assurance. Around 4,000 property registrations were completed under Madhya Pradesh's SVAMITVA scheme against a target of nearly 50 lakh after patwaris resumed work on Tuesday. Bhopal's Adampur Landfill Management Handed To Saurashtra Firm For 5 Years, BMC Approves rupees 200 Crore Green Bonds. Bhopal Municipal Corporation approved a five-year, rupees 48 crore contract for scientific processing of 800 metric tonnes of daily waste at Adampur landfill. Madhya Pradesh Teacher Promotion 2026 DPI Orders Service Record Verification Of 6,500 Teachers By October 25, 32,000 Posts Vacant. Madhya Pradesh's Directorate of Public Instruction has ordered verification of service records, confidential reports and seniority lists of 6,500 higher secondary teachers by October 25. Bhopal Gas Tragedy: 42 Years Later. Indore Fire Guts 13 Seized Cars, Auto-Rickshaw At Excise Department Warehouse Near Silicon City. A massive fire gutted 13 seized cars and an auto-rickshaw at an excise department warehouse in Indore's Kadambari Nagar on Tuesday. ICAR-CIAE, Bhopal and M/s. Natures Bioplastics Pvt. Ltd. Developes Biodegradable films for Milk and water Packaging. Indore Food Safety Team Collects 20 Samples From Restaurants, Shops And Food Units, Finds Hygiene Lapses. Indore Food Safety Administration collected 20 samples during inspections of restaurants, food outlets and manufacturing units over two days. Indore Thieves Target Jain Temple, Two Houses In Separate Burglaries, Steal Cash And Gold Jewellery. Thieves targeted Shitalnath Jain Shwetamber Temple and two houses in separate burglary incidents across Indore. Too loud to ignore: 7 in 10 Bhopal junctions breach noise limits, PCB survey finds. Indore Collector Shivam Verma Orders Faster Road, Bridge And Flyover Construction, 24 Paid Parking Locations Identified. Indore Collector Shivam Verma directed officials to accelerate road, bridge and flyover construction while improving diversions and pedestrian safety. Daily Madhya Pradesh Current Affairs for MPPSC Exam (14-10-2026). MP's Ujjain Faces Water Crisis After Poor Rainfall, Narmada Supply To Replenish Depleting Gambhir Dam. Poor rainfall has raised water shortage concerns in Ujjain, with Gambhir Dam's reserves falling to 690 McFt against its 2,250 McFt capacity. MP to offer bus ticket bookings from home: Online reservations like trains, with app launch planned soon. 80 newborn deaths at Madhya Pradesh hospital in six months, BJP MLA calls for probe. Indore Horror On MR-10 As Stolen Tempo Traveller Hits Bikes, Overturns Loading Auto Before Crashing Into Pole. A stolen Tempo Traveller caused chaos on Indore's MR-10 road Tuesday, hitting motorcycles and overturning a cement-laden loading auto before crashing into a pole. Madhya Pradesh Government Orders Major IAS Reshuffle; Rashmi Arun Shami Gets Additional Charge as Revenue Board Chairman. Indore Navratri Pandal Blocks Entire Gandhinagar Road, High Court Asks Whether Organisers Obtained Permission. Madhya Pradesh High Court's Indore bench questioned whether organisers obtained permission to block Gandhinagar main road with a Navratri pandal. Decline in stubble burning in Northern states, concerns raised for Madhya Pradesh and Rajasthan. MP's Ujjain Patni Bazaar Reopens After Traders' Protest, Road Widening Suspended Until Diwali. Patni Bazaar and Gopal Mandir markets in Ujjain reopened Tuesday after authorities suspended the Mahakal Chauraha-Qumari Marg road-widening project until Diwali.

transcript.title: Business and markets
transcript.text: Moving to business, the economy and the markets. Sebi proposes tighter IPO proceeds monitoring, fines for defaulting firms. Sebi proposes mandatory monitoring agencies for all issuances, with stock exchanges empowered to levy fines and freeze promoters' demat accounts for persistent non-cooperation IT stocks lead markets to biggest rally in four months on HCLTech boost. HCLTech results spark 5.22 percent surge in IT index, highest in 17 months; FM's remarks on LTCG tax lift sentiment, too Sebi extends relaxation to revise fresh issue size till March 2027. IPO-bound companies can increase or decrease fresh issue sizes by up to 50 per cent without filing fresh draft offer documents, provided the main objective of the issue remains unchanged Stockbrokers brace for slower revenue growth amid weaker trading activity. The average daily premium turnover (ADPT) in index options on the National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) fell 27 percent sequentially in the September quarter, according to exchange data. Average daily turnover in the cash segment declined 19 percent over the same period. Shriram Finance rallies 7 percent ; what's driving NBFC stock price?. Shriram Finance stock corrected 10 percent over the past month amid a combination of factors, including renewed escalation in the West Asia conflict, a sharp rebound in crude prices and elevated bond yields. Market volatility puts lump-sum investing in focus as SIP growth slows. While SIP contributions climbed to a record rupees 32,490 crore in September, the slowdown is in the growth rate, not in the absolute amount invested. ICICI Life Insurance share price drops 4 percent from day's high post Q2 results. ICICI Life Insurance on Tuesday reported 25 percent YoY jump in Q2FY27 net profit at rupees 374.22 crore, backed by 16.6 percent YoY growth in net premium income at rupees 13,803.90 crore. Hong Kong's Low Aggregate Balance Sparks Rate Volatility Concern. As the Hong Kong dollar nears the weak end of its trading band, strategists see currency defenses raising the risk of volatility in borrowing costs, with interbank cash reserves sitting near historical lows. Nestle India Q2 preview: Strong volumes to drive growth; PAT may top rupees 1k cr. Nestle India could outperform peers, supported by strong brand franchises, resilient demand, efficient distribution networks and disciplined cost management, said brokerages. A $29 Billion Manager Tips Nigerian Stocks Over South Korea's Kospi. Allan Gray Ltd., which oversees $29 billion in assets, favors Nigerian stocks over South Korean equities, as they offer a diversification play from the artificial-intelligence frenzy that has swept markets from Wall Street to Asia. Cable and Wire stocks: Polycab, KEI, R R Kabel, Quadrant Future slip up to 5 percent. As of Tuesday, Polycab, KEI Industries, R R Kabel and Quadrant Future Tek were down up to 24 percent from their respective 52-week highs touched in September. Oil Rally Peters Out With Mideast, Russia Tensions in Focus. Oil held steady after three sessions of gains as traders booked profits from the recent rally while threats to energy supplies continued to loom from the Middle East to Russia. Paytm, Mobikwik, Pine Labs rebound even as NPCI defers MDR on UPI; read why. The MDR, which was to be applicable from October 15, will now come into force after Diwali, according to a notification by NPCI. CJP leaders under preventive arrest for trespassing. Delhi Police detained Cockroach Janata Party activists Saurav Das, Ashutosh Ranka, and Ajinkya Shinde for trespassing. Oil Eases From Three-Day Gain With Focus on Middle East, Russia. Oil held steady after three days of gains as traders booked profits from the recent rally amid persistent risks to energy supplies stretch from the Middle East to Russia. PNB Gilts stock zooms 12 percent ; pares gains post Q2 results. PNB Gilts on Tuesday reported a turnaround in Q2 net profit on a YoY basis, but PAT was down 44 percent on a QoQ basis. US hits BofA with $1.2 bn money laundering fine. The US Treasury Department announced a $1.2 billion fine against Bank of America for violating anti-money laundering laws. Copper Slips as AI Selloff Saps Appetite for Risk Across Markets. Copper wavered as traders weighed investor angst around overheated spending on metal-intensive AI infrastructure against continued supply risks. Mirae Asset: Oil volatility to rise ahead of midterm; Brent may test $120. Mohammed Imran of Mirae Asset Sharekhan expects Brent to become more volatile ahead of the US midterm election. Brent futures may test the resistance of $120/b in the near term. Bihar boat capsize kills 13 children aged under 15. At least 13 children drowned in the Ganga river when a boat capsized in Bihar's Vaishali district. US Swaps Bets Backfire, Wiping Out Billions From Funds in Chile. The pension funds used by millions of Chileans are racing to close out bets on US interest rates that backfired after the Iran war unleashed a global inflation shock, exposing them to billions of dollars of losses. Maruti Suzuki tanks 33 percent in calendar year 2026; stock hits 18-month low. Maruti Suzuki: The stock traded at its lowest point since April 2025 amid worries that profitability could take a hit owing to high commodity prices in the near term. NCC Ltd Chairman Emeritus AVS Raju passes away. AVS Raju, the Founder and Chairman Emeritus of NCC Limited, passed away on October 13, 2026. Dividend, rights issue record date: Last chance to buy today - Shivam Autotech, Shraddha Prime, Anand Rathi Wealth. Shivam Autotech and Shraddha Prime Projects have set October 15, 2026, as the record date for their rights issues. Anand Rathi Wealth also chose that date for its rupees 4 interim dividend, after reporting 22 percent September-quarter profit growth. SMIDs rally heats up bets in IPO and secondary market; raises bar on earnings. Smaller IPOs delivered stronger returns than larger issues in the six months, while retail money increasingly flowed into small- and mid-cap funds Noel Tata makes pre-emptive move amid Trust battle. Noel Tata and his son Neville filed a caveat petition in the Mumbai City Civil Court against other trustees. Gold subdued ahead of US inflation data, Warsh remarks. GLOBAL-PRECIOUS/ (UPDATE 8):PRECIOUS-Gold subdued ahead of US inflation data, Warsh remarks Nifty at 26,500 in 4-5 months: What's behind Monarch Capital's bull call?. Nifty target: Monarch Networth Capital expects the index to hit new all-time highs of 26,000-26,500 within the next 4-5 months, suggesting an upside of 18 per cent from the last close. Two ships hit by projectiles in Strait of Hormuz. A tanker and a container ship were struck by projectiles of unknown origin in the Strait of Hormuz. Capital goods stocks fall after multibagger rally. Is this a buying opportunity for long-term investors?. Despite a recent pause in the rally over valuation concerns, 360 ONE identifies multi-year growth drivers for power transmission equipment, including HVDC systems, grid upgrades, renewable integration and data centers.

transcript.title: Money, tax and personal finance
transcript.text: Now to your money — taxes, savings and personal finance. LIC to launch three new insurance plans on October 19, 2026: Annuity, health insurance and cancer cover to go on offer. Life Insurance Corporation of India is set to introduce three new insurance products on October 19, 2026. The offerings include LIC's New Jeevan Dhara - II, LIC's Health Shield, and LIC's New Cancer Cover. CBDT sends tax audit reminders to nearly 12,000 professionals ahead of 21 October deadline: What is SAKSHAM NUDGE?. The CBDT has expanded its SAKSHAM NUDGE initiative to include tax professionals, sending nearly 12,000 reminders to those with lower-than-usual tax audit filings. Woman applied for 130 shares in Adani Wilmar IPO, bank entered only 65; she sought rupees 40L compensation; gets relief in consumer commission. The woman had earlier appealed in the district commission which held that she did not qualify as a consumer and that the complaint was not maintainable on the ground that investment in shares is a commercial activity. Then why did she won in the State Consumer Commission? Find out in this article. LIC to launch three insurance plans on 19 October: Benefits, features and eligibility explained. LIC will offer three new insurance plans from 19 October 2026. New Jeevan Dhara-II provides deferred annuity income, Health Shield offers fixed health benefits, and New Cancer Cover provides financial payouts for specified cancer diagnoses. 'Earn 30 percent monthly': SBI warns how fraudsters can lure you with tempting offers and what you should do. Fraudulent investment schemes lure investors with the illusion of high returns and minimal risk. The State Bank of India (SBI) warns that scammers often apply undue pressure for quick investments, employing unusual payment methods to do so. These deceitful schemes are commonly endorsed by unknown social media influencers, giving them a false sense of credibility. PPF account declared irregular after 12 years: What happens to your interest? High Court ruling explained. The Karnataka High Court ruled that postal authorities could not deny PPF interest after allowing an irregular HUF account to operate for 12 years. The decision highlights the authorities' responsibility for irregularities they permitted. How much gold and silver jewellery can you have in your home without getting into trouble with the Income Tax authorities?. How much pure silver and gold jewellery can you have in your home without getting into trouble with the Income Tax authorities? To know the answer you need to read CBDT Instruction No. 1916. Stocks, mutual funds, gold and property: How LTCG tax differs across asset classes. LTCG tax rules differ across stocks, mutual funds, gold and property, with different holding periods, tax rates and exemptions. Here is what investors need to know about the tax treatment of their investments under the current framework. Senior citizen gets income tax notice over rupees 65.27 lakh cash deposit in bank account; his son proves source of funds and wins case in ITAT Jaipur. Senior citizen sent income tax notice for rupees 65.27 lakh unexplained cash deposit, which was later proved to be pension and FD money; ITAT Jaipur order explained. Buying property in a relative's name? Key benami law and tax risks to know. Buying property in a spouse's, child's or parent's name can invite benami law and tax scrutiny if ownership and funding arrangements do not meet legal requirements. Know the statutory exemptions, potential penalties and documents buyers should maintain to establish legitimate ownership Inflation is up again; should you invest in FDs now or wait for interest rates to rise further? Check what a 1 percent hike means for your rupees 2 lakh FD. FD rate hike: In September 2026, retail inflation soared to 5.54 percent , sparking opinions about the possibility of interest rate hikes on fixed deposits.
